, the holding company for First Commerce Bank, said on Monday that Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer David Onderko will retire effective September 28, 2026.
The company said Chief Accounting Officer Naqi Naqvi will serve as interim CFO while the bank searches for a permanent successor.
Onderko will stay on as a consultant to First Commerce Bank through December 31, 2026, to support a smooth transition and complete the bank's core data conversion.
The bank has engaged Kaplan Partners to assist with the recruitment of its new CFO.

title: First Commerce Bancorp CFO David Onderko to retire
